title: Cherry Hill Mortgage Investment Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Cherry Hill Mortgage Investment Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 6, 2026 disclosing approval of the 2026 Executive Compensation Plan for three named executive officers. The plan includes base salary, a short-term incentive program (STIP), and a long-term incentive program (LTIP). CEO Jay Lown receives $900,000 base salary, CIO Julian Evans $550,000, and CFO Apeksha Patel $400,000.
key_points: 2026 Executive Compensation Plan approved by Board on April 6, 2026, effective January 1, 2026
CEO base salary: $900,000; CIO base salary: $550,000; CFO base salary: $400,000
STIP awards range from threshold to maximum as percentages of base salary (CEO: 20-60%, CIO/CFO: 25-75%)
STIP performance metrics: 70% based on Company financial performance (50% EAD ROE, 50% price-to-tangible book value vs peer group), 30% individual performance goals
LTIP covers rolling 3-year tranches beginning January 1, 2026 through December 31, 2028
Company transitioned to internal management structure in November 2024
